full_description: use one arm to pick up the block; the approach-direction phrase in the instruction selects whether to grasp it from the top or from the side
schema: {A} notifies the block. {D} is the approach-direction phrase the instruction commands (a top-family phrase like 'from the top' when the task is to grasp from above, a side-family phrase like 'from the side' when the task is to grasp horizontally) — it is the ONLY signal of which approach to use. {a} notifies the arm. Every template MUST contain both {D} and {A}, with {D} immediately after {A}. Do NOT write 'the' immediately before {A} or {a}; both already render with a leading article.
preference: num of words should not exceed 7!!!!!. Degree of detail avg is 2. Keep the direction slot {D} right after the object {A}.
